gui.vhtoolforge.title: VH Tool Forge
gui.vhtoolforge.targets.header_flags_lef: YES / NO STATS · TICKED = MUST HAVE
gui.vhtoolforge.targets.footnote: Unique jewels, sizes and recipes are read from this pack's config/the_vault files.
gui.vhtoolforge.why.over: §cThe ticked unique jewels need more capacity than this tool has.
gui.vhtoolforge.why.enter_target: Enter a target to start planning.
gui.vhtoolforge.why.level_rises: Tool level rises to %s from the highest jewel.
gui.vhtoolforge.why.none_scanned: §eNo jewels scanned yet: open a storage and press Scan.
gui.vhtoolforge.sources.header_right: UNTICK TO LEAVE ONE OUT OF THE PLAN
gui.vhtoolforge.sources.empty: Nothing scanned yet. Open an AE2 terminal, RS grid, chest or barrel and press Scan beside it.
gui.vhtoolforge.sources.help: Each storage screen gets a Scan button. Scanning again replaces that storage's list. AE2 terminals and RS grids are read in full, whatever the search or tab shows.
gui.vhtoolforge.plan.empty: No plan yet: enter targets on the Targets tab, and scan some storage.
gui.vhtoolforge.plan.group_unique_sub: not found in a scan: collect by hand
gui.vhtoolforge.plan.group_craft: Craft at the Jewel Crafting Table
gui.vhtoolforge.plan.group_gone: Storage forgotten since the plan was locked
gui.vhtoolforge.plan.no_backpack: No Sophisticated Backpack in your main inventory or hotbar.
gui.vhtoolforge.plan.step_1: 1. Open a storage listed on the left.
gui.vhtoolforge.plan.step_3: 3. Each jewel goes onto the cursor, then is right-clicked into the backpack.
gui.vhtoolforge.plan.step_4: 4. Move on to the next storage.
message.vhtoolforge.not_a_storage: This screen is not a scanned storage.
message.vhtoolforge.no_backpack: Choose a backpack in the Tool Forge screen first (main inventory or hotbar).
message.vhtoolforge.stopped_cursor_busy: Stopped: something is on the cursor.
message.vhtoolforge.stopped_unplanned: Stopped: an unplanned item came out and is on your cursor.
message.vhtoolforge.stopped_put_back_fai: Stopped: could not put an unplanned jewel back. It is on your cursor.
message.vhtoolforge.stopped_no_backpack: Stopped: the backpack is not in your main inventory or hotbar. The jewel is on your cursor.
message.vhtoolforge.stopped_backpack_ful: Stopped: the backpack did not take the jewel (full?). It is on your cursor.
tooltip.vhtoolforge.storage_buttons: Show or hide the Scan and Collect buttons beside storage screens.
tooltip.vhtoolforge.storage_buttons_note: Takes effect the next time a storage screen opens.
tooltip.vhtoolforge.base_type_hammer: Only a hammer base can have Hammering and Hammer Size.
tooltip.vhtoolforge.base_type_other: Other tool types can be added with jewels.
tooltip.vhtoolforge.extra_capacity: Tick if you have the prestige unlock that adds tool capacity.
tooltip.vhtoolforge.extra_capacity_note: Enter how much it adds in the box.
tooltip.vhtoolforge.priority_note: Unranked stats share the lowest weight.
tooltip.vhtoolforge.flag_nice: Nice to have: taken when it earns its space.
tooltip.vhtoolforge.flag_must: Must have: covered before anything else.
tooltip.vhtoolforge.flag_craft: If none is stored: craft one (size %s)
tooltip.vhtoolforge.source_forget: Forget this storage and its jewels.
tooltip.vhtoolforge.jewel_craft: Not in storage. Craft it at the Jewel Crafting Table:
tooltip.vhtoolforge.jewel_unique: Ticked unique, not found in any scan. Collect it by hand.
tooltip.vhtoolforge.lock_plan: Freeze the plan so collecting does not change it. Collect locks it automatically.
tooltip.vhtoolforge.unlock_plan: Throw away the locked plan and plan again from what is in storage now.
tooltip.vhtoolforge.scan: Remember every jewel in this storage for VH Tool Forge
tooltip.vhtoolforge.collect_no_backpack: Choose a target backpack in the Tool Forge screen first
tooltip.vhtoolforge.collect: Move this storage's planned jewels into %s (%s)
